articles.title: Foreign_relations_of_Tierrador
articles.snippet:
The '''Foreign relations of Tierrador''' detail the opinions of that the [[Tierrador|Tierradorian Woqalate]] holds concerning the rest of the world. Tierradorian foreign policy is unanimously governed by the [[Woqali of Tierrador|Imperial Crown]] and [[Government of Tierrador|Imperial Government]]. For most of its history, Tierrador (At the time the [[Qabóri Woqalate]]) had mostly confined its interests within its former colonies in [[South Crona]], and later branched out through new colonies in [[Polynesia]], along with heavy deals with powers in [[Vallos]] and [[Audonia]] in the 19th and 20th centuries. Tierrador prioritizes the strong ties with its regional allies within the [[Tierrosphere]], along with the remaining [[Crona|Cronan]] allies not part of of the sphere. Tierrador is an active participant in global trade, defense cooperation, and multilateral diplomacy, while also being a major contributor in humanitarian, economic, and military aid to various nations around the world.

== History ==

== Contemporary relations ==

Since the beginning of the 21st century, Tierrador and Urcea had continued to maintain friendly diplomatic relations for each other. Most of the 21st century history in [[Crona]] had been characterized by the outbreak of the [[The Deluge|Deluge]] in 2008, which saw the toppling of the [[Zurgite Varshan|Zurgite Varshani]] hegemony over [[North Crona]] and part of [[Central Crona]]. The Woqalate had supported the war efforts in North Crona though were skeptical because of further Occidental neo-colonial ambitions that came after it. Regardless, both nations would benefit greatly from a Bilateral Trade Agreement that was signed in August 2009, and various mutual defense agreements in the early-2010s following the rise in tensions between Varshan and [[South Crona]].

With the unfolding of the [[Final War of the Deluge]], Tierrador fought with the [[League of Nations]] Coalition and helped the Urcean-led Coalition push through southern Varshan on the way to [[Anzo]]. articles.title: Foreign_relations_of_Galata
articles.snippet:
The '''foreign relations of Galata''' are linked to its history and its reputation as "on [[Levantia]] but apart from it". [[Galata]] is a member of the [[League of Nations]], but not the [[Levantine Union]]. LU membership has been a prominent issue in Galatan foreign policy.

== History ==
Historically, Galatan foreign policy focused on preserving its independence, primarily from [[Great Levantia]] and the [[Holy Levantine Empire]]. 

The Kingdom's long medieval period, surrounded by the Holy Levantine Empire and marked by militarisation, border conflicts and uneasy peaces, shaped Galatan diplomacy.

Queen [[List of notable Galatans#Dubnorīgā|Dubnorīgā]] began Galata's colonial empire, creating fully integrated colonies with native citizens and encouraging intermarriage. This was meant to mobilise the country towards a unifying national effort, export class conflicts abroad, and escape the sense of being "boxed in" on Levantia.

Defeat in the [[Dericani-Galatan Border War]] prompted the collapse of [[List of notable Galatans#Iantumāros|Iantumāros]]' royal dictatorship and the three revolutionary years. The war was described by some historians as a "lasting scar" on Galatan foreign

articles.snippet:
{{Politics of Nasastan}}

The [[Nasastan|National Federation of Nasastan]] is a federal parliamentary authoritarian republic characterized by a political system of [[Guided democracy|managed pluralism]]. Under the [[Constitution of Nasastan|Constitution of 1937]], political participation is structured through a unique asymmetric bicameral legislature that separates economic governance from sociocultural deliberation. While the country permits a degree of multiparty competition, the [[Ethnofederalist Social Nasastani National Party]] (SNNSP) functions as the dominant legal and administrative framework of the state. Political activity in Nasastan is divided according to the specific competencies of the two parliamentary chambers; The [[Purokal]] (Economic Chamber)''':''' Membership is strictly restricted to representatives of the SNNSP. Economic debate is not conducted between rival parties but within five internal ideological factions of the SNNSP, which range from far-left to far-right economic currents. articles.title: Kiravian_federalism
articles.snippet:
The [[Kiravian Federacy]] is structured as an {{wp|asymmetric federation}} in which the powers and responsibilities of governance are shared between the '''[[Government of the Kiravian Federacy|federal government]]''' and the governments of the various '''federal subjects''', which include states, territories, and other regional entities, also referred to generically in Ænglish as '''provinces'''. The degree to and manner in which the federal subjects are self-governing varies according to their [[Kiravian federalism#Classes|classification]] and the particular details of their constituting documents. 

==History==
{{See also|Constitutional History of Kiravia}}

Under the Confederal Republics of Kirav, the purview of Confederal government was quite narrow, mainly limited to maintaining a common currency, enforcing customs, defensive works and raising armies in times of war, diplomatic and Urom relations, and running the Navy and postal service. '''The Burgundies''', also known as the ''4 Burgundies'', is the legal term for the supranational concept that collectively represents the following bodies:

* The Crown of Burgundie

articles.title: Dericania
articles.snippet:
'''Dericania''' refers to the region in [[Levantia]] radiating out from the eastern coast. It is bordered to the north by [[Fiannria]] and to the west by [[Urcea]]. In the historical sense, it includes [[Burgundie]] (see the [[Kingdom of Dericania]]). In the modern sense, it excludes [[Burgundie]] (see the [[Deric States]]). For the reasoning as to why this is the case see [[The Two Derics]].

'''Dericania''' may specifically refer to:

* [[Kingdom of Dericania]], a kingdom of the [[Holy Levantine Empire]]
* [[Deric States]], a collection of independent states formed from the Kingdom of Dericania after the collapse of the Holy Levantine Empire
==Etymology==
Dericania first appears in the historical record in the late 9th century, though it did not become the consensus name for the region until about the 11th century. The name derives from the ''[[Via Dericanus]]'', the best known trade and travel route in this part of Levantia that was constructed by [[Great Levantia]]. Due to the centrality of this route in the lives of people living in central Levantia, the name was applied to the entire region, i.e. the ''land of the Via Dericanus''. [[File:RNP flag.svg|thumb|330px|The flag of the [[Republican Nationalist Party]], containing a [[Coscivian civilisation|four-pointed star]] representing the four principles and their Coscivian inspiration.]]
'''Restarkism''', ([[Cape Coscivian]]: ''Restarkizme'', archaically ''Rektarizm''), or '''the Four Principles''', is the founding ideology of the [[the Cape|Federacy of the Cape]]. Developed by [[Melvyn Kalma]], it is a philosophy with the aim of developing and uniting the Cape into a modern, [[Occidental]], and powerful state. As defined by him, it is a national liberation ideology with the broad goal of uniting the ethnically disparate peoples of the country and separating the new nation from its previous tribal and colonial roots. To this day, Restarkism remains the official constitutional {{wp|ideology|state ideology}} of the Federacy, and is the guiding philosophy of the {{wp|dominant-party system|dominant}} [[Republican Nationalist Party]].

articles.title: Correctional_system_of_Caphiria
articles.snippet:
{{politics of Caphiria}}
The '''correctional system of Caphiria''' (including prisons) is part of the [[criminal justice system of Caphiria]]. The correctional system operates under the Department of Incarceration, part of the [[Ministry of Justice (Caphiria)|Ministry of Justice]]. The Department of Incarceration have the primary role, responsibility and authority to change prison laws, rules and regulations.The correctional system is split between an administrative detention system and a judicial incarceration system, each with its own types of staff, facilities, and procedures.

Caphirian law makes a legal distinction between the concepts of detainment, indictment, and imprisonment. As such, the balance of power is spread very evenly across the correctional system and the legal system, and the legal authority across the various departments is very clear.

articles.title: Pelaxian_Socialism
articles.snippet:
Pelaxian Socialism is a political, social, and economic philosophy of Marxist origing encompassing a range political theories, and social systems characterised by social ownership of the means of production. It includes the economic policies and movements associated with such systems. Social ownership can be public, collective, cooperative, or of equity. 

While no single definition encapsulates the many types of principles, social ownership is the one common element that has been higlighted in the 21st century. 

Historically Pelaxian Socialists disagreed about the degree to which social control or regulation of the economy is necessary, how far society should intervene and whether government, particularly existing government, is the correct vehicle for change. Pelaxian Socialism lines of thought have been divided in non-market and market forms. Non-market socialism substitutes factor markets and money with integrated economic planning and engineering or technical criteria based on calculation performed in-kind, thereby producing a different economic mechanism that functions according to different economic laws and dynamics than those of capitalism. articles.title: Liberty_Index
articles.snippet:
The '''International Liberty Index Foundation''' is a [[League of Nations]]-sanctioned NGO centered on recording and comparing global survey and analytical data to produce comprehensive data for a number of metrics centered around the spread of political freedoms and systems, corruption in governments and societies, social values and norms, and civil rights. Originally founded in 1958 in Cartadania in conjunction with the Organization for Democracy International, the ILIF originally managed a League-sanctioned set of indexes: the the Democracy Index, the Civil Rights Index, and the Perceived Corruption Index. Individually, each is scored to a maximum value of 10, the highest of which sets the year's benchmark. Scores for these indices are also available comparatively between years to show the improvement of benchmark-setters year by year. These are typically shown compiled into a single score in the form of the Liberty Index, a {{wp|norm-referenced test|norm-referenced scoring system}} which provides a relative, simple view of a country's overall social and political freedoms. 

Over time, the ILIF has expanded to cover a number of analytical metrics, absorbing several related NGOs

articles.title: Criminal_justice_system_of_Urcea
articles.snippet:
{{Urcea WIP}}

The '''criminal justice system of Urcea''' is the means by which the [[Consolidated Laws of HMCM's Kingdom and State|laws of Urcea]] are enforced. In [[Urcea]], each [[Federalism in Urcea|constituent entity]] also maintains its own criminal and civil code in addition to nationwide statutes, and most crimes are prosecuted at the subdivision level. 

==History==
Trials for crimes and civil suits in [[Urcea]] are first attested to during the medieval period, with most occurring under the auspices of arbitrators appointed by the [[Apostolic King of Urcea]] or by local nobles, with irregular procedure followed in most cases. The [[Great Bull of 1811]] guaranteed the right to speedy trial by jury, establishing a baseline for civil rights of the accused, a guarantee which functionally revolutionized criminal justice. Over time, Urcean courts came to interpret the Bull's [[Great_Bull_of_1811#Eighth_Statement|Eighth Statement]] as conferring the {{Wp|presumption of innocence}}. Protocols_Act_of_2023
articles.snippet:

The '''Protocols Act of 2023''' is an act of the [[Conshilía Daoni]] which changed the relationship between [[Urcea]] and full members of the [[Nysdra Sea Treaty Association]] (NSTA), which was also amended to reflect the Protocols Act. The Act, which amended the [[Consolidated Laws of HMCM's Kingdom and State|Diplomatic Law and the Foreign Dependencies Law]], allows the Ministries of the [[Conshilía Purpháidhe]] to directly interact with full members of NSTA without need of diplomatic protocol or use of the [[Ministry of State (Urcea)|Ministry of State]] as an intermediary. The act was intended to, in the words of the legislation's sponsor, "more fully integrate the economic and social direction of NSTA members towards the goal of mutual prosperity and security". The bill passed the Conshilía Daoni by a vote of 432-40 on March 8th, [[2023]]. It also removed the Ministry of State and [[Ministry_of_Administration_of_the_Realm_(Urcea)#Office_for_Territorial_Management|Office for Territorial Management]] as intermediaries between the Urcean government and its two union states, [[New Harren]] and [[Lariana]].

articles.title: Royal_and_Provincial_Tax_Act_of_2020
articles.snippet:
{{stub}}

The '''Royal and Provincial Tax Act of 2020''' is an act of the [[Conshilía Daoni]] which made significant overhauls to the tax system of [[Urcea]]. The Act, which amended the [[Consolidated_Laws_of_HMCM%27s_Kingdom_and_State|Tax Law, Province Law, Crownland Law, and State Law]], abolished the three types of different taxes levied by the [[Government of Urcea]] on the three types of subdivisions ([[Province (Urcea)|provinces]], [[Crownland (Urcea)|crownlands]], and [[State (Urcea)|states]]). These taxes were replaced by a direct income tax on all citizens of [[Urcea]] regardless of where they lived, and also leveled various administrative fees and specific-application use taxes. The Act, which was a major campaign platform of [[Bridget Farrell]] and the [[National Pact (Urcea)|National Pact]], was passed on a party line vote of 290-210. It proved to be an extremely contentious issue in the [[2020 Urcean elections]]. In the 2021-22 fiscal year, the [[Government of Urcea]] reported a "significant surge" in state budget incomes as a result, and many analysts have suggested that the increase in taxes helped Urcea pay for the [[Final War of the Deluge]].

Holy_League
articles.snippet:
{{stub}}

The '''Holy League''' was a coalition of [[Catholic Church|Catholic]] members within the [[Holy Levantine Empire]] during the mid-16th century who were joined together for the purposes of defending the Empire generally and the Catholic ascendancy within it specifically. Unlike its opposition, the [[Protestant Union]], the Holy League had no central leadership but was a coalition of many different members of the [[Kingdom of Dericania]] and principalities within future [[Fiannria]]. The Holy League was established in response to the creation of the [[Protestant Union]] as a way to coordinate the Catholic war effort during the [[Great Confessional War]] and protect the lands and territories of its constituent members. It was dissolved with the Catholic victory during the Great Confessional War, and its members - especially those founding families and princes of the League - benefitted from the war greatly, gaining the lands and territories of disinherited {{wp|Protestant}} lords.

articles.title: Latin_League
articles.snippet:
{{stub}}

The '''Latin League''' was a coalition of [[Latinic people|Latinic]] successor states and city-states following the collapse of central authority of [[Great Levantia]] in the beginning of the 6th century. The League was established in the 670s for the purposes of mutual defense against [[Gothic people|Goths]] to the north, [[Gallawa]] to the east, and later [[Uzdehzanistan]] to the south. The [[Urcepól (Duchy)|Duchy of Urcepól]] and [[Harren#Independent_Ducal_period|Duchy of Hortia]], the [[Kingdom of Pumbria]], and the duchies of [[Urcea Maritima]] were among its most prominent members. It was destroyed in the 750s by [[Conchobar I, Emperor of the Levantines|Conchobar]], King of Gallawa, whose control of the former Latin heartland would empower him to form the [[Holy Levantine Empire|Levantine Empire]] shortly after its demise. The lands of most of these cities and polities were reorganized into the [[Urcepól (Archduchy)|Archduchy of Urcepól]], [[Harren|Duchy of Harren]], and the various [[Creagmer republics]] of the western coast. articles.title: Vandarch_Sea_Trade_Zone_Organization
articles.snippet:
The Vandarch Sea Trade Zone Organization is an economic pact formed in 1978 governing international shipping and flights across the [[Vandarch Sea]], which is referred to in the organization's charter as the Vandarch Sea Administrative Zone. It manages joint communications between flight control and maritime bodies within the Sea, establishes maximum limits on tariffs at ports in the Zone, guarantees port-of-refuge rights to all ships of member nations in the Vandarch Sea, and regulated fishing to maintain the Vandarch's ecosphere. The VSTZO is based out of [[Sethsport]], [[Faneria]], and is composed of a top-level council of one representative per member nation.

The '''Administrative Reorganization Act of 1892''' was [[Index of Urcean legislation|an act]] of the [[Urcea|Urcean]] [[Conshilía Daoni]] during the [[History_of_Urcea_(1798-1902)#Crown_Regency_and_Red_Interregnum|Crown Regency]] of [[Gréagóir FitzRex]]. The Act eliminated the last vestiges of feudal political organization by sweeping away a large number of crownlands, provinces, free cities, counties, [[Plantatía]]r, duchies, and {{wp|Imperial circles}} and subsequently began a nation-wide survey of land in order to redraw provincial boundaries and to create [[Local government in Urcea|rational local governments]], a process which was mostly completed in 1895. The Act was intended to create a {{wp|federalism|federal}} political structure in [[Urcea]] based on the principles elucidated in the [[Great_Bull_of_1811#Fifth_Statement|Fifth Statement]] of the [[Great Bull of 1811]]. The Act exempted three crownlands - the [[Urcepól (Archduchy)|Archduchy of Urcepól]] and the [[Harren|Grand Duchy of Harren]] - since it was unclear from the [[Constitution of Urcea]] and [[Golden Bull of 1098]] if these two integral parts of the Kingdom could be legally abolished. articles.snippet:
{{stub}}

The '''League of Nations Wartime Benefit Fund''' is a fund established by the [[Treaty of Electorsbourg (2024)|Treaty of Electorsbourg]] intended to benefit the orphans and widows of [[League of Nations Command]] soldiers during the [[Final War of the Deluge]]. The fund was created using the proceeds from sales of military and other equipment captured from [[Varshan]] at the end of the war, particularly warships. The fund, established under the auspices of the [[Provost-General of the League of Nations]], coordinated with participating nations to establish benefit programs on the national level with which the Fund provides block grant funding. While most criteria is established at the national level, the Fund requires that benefit be provided to the spouses of or children of service members who are eligible for the [[League of Nations Service Medal]] and who died in the line of service.

articles.title: The_Dispossessed
articles.snippet: '''The Dispossessed''' is a term which refers to a large number of former nobles and Royals who presently reside in [[Urcepól (City)|Urcepól]], and especially the [[Urcepól_(City)#Ardriville|borough of Ardriville]], following losing their ancestral possessions and homelands. The vast majority of these nobles come from the [[Deric States]] and lost their ancestral principalities during the [[Second Great War]], but some come from other [[Levantia|Levantine]] countries, including the former royal family of [[Ardmore]]. The earliest emigre family, however, is the royal family of [[Arona#Republic_established|Arona]], the only [[Vallos|Vallosian]] family among the Dispossessed, arriving in Urcea in [[1920]]. The Dispossessed are noted for living lives of extravagance within [[Urcepól_(City)#Ardriville|Ardriville]], maintaining a sense of insular {{wp|High society (social class)|high society}} among their own number and hosting lavish balls while also sponsoring works of art. The homes of the Dispossessed are a popular tourist landmark within [[Urcepól (City)|Urcepól]] but most can only be seen from afar. articles.title: Golden_Bull_of_1098
articles.snippet:
{{stub}}

The '''Golden Bull of 1098''' was a {{wp|Golden bull|golden bull}} issued by [[Saint Charles II|Emperor Charles II]] in [[1098]] which reorganized the [[Southern Kingdom of the Levantines]] as the [[Imperial Kingdom of Urcea]] and conveyed the title of King on the [[Julian dynasty]]. It is the constituting act which established [[Urcea]] as a cohesive political entity, and remains the foundational legal act on which the Kingdom is based. The Julian dynasty had been the most powerful political force within the Southern Kingdom since the unification of [[Urcepól (Archduchy)|Urcepól]] and [[Harren]], the two realms which were fused by the golden bull and established as the two integral parts of the new Kingdom. Under the terms of the Golden Bull of 1098, all previous vassals of the Southern King of the Levantines were transferred to the new [[Apostolic King of Urcea]], although in practice many continued to have considerably autonomy or effective {{wp|imperial immediacy}}.

articles.title: Freedom_of_the_seas
articles.snippet:
'''Freedom of the seas''' ([[Burgoignesc language|Burg]]: mare liberum), is a principle in the international law and most recently written into statute as the [[League of Nations]]' Law of the Sea (LoNLoS). It stresses freedom to navigate the oceans. It also disapproves but does not ban, wars fought in water. The freedom is to be breached only in a necessary international agreement.
[[File:"Freedom of Seas is in Your Hands" - NARA - 514332.jpg|thumb|right|Freedom of the Seas, poster from the Great War era]]
This principle was first codified, internationally, following the [[Second Great War]], by the Great Prince of [[Burgundie]], who spoke of it thusly:
{{quote|Absolute freedom of navigation upon the seas, outside territorial waters, alike in peace and in war, except as the seas may be closed in whole or in part by international action for the enforcement of international covenants.}}
Today, the concept of "freedom of the seas" can be found in the [[League of Nations]]' Law of the Sea (LoNLoS), which states: "the high seas are open to all sovereign states, whether coastal or land-locked". International_League_of_Radio_Amateurs
articles.snippet:
The '''International League of Radio Amateurs''' is an international confederation of national organizations that allows a forum for common matters of concern to amateur radio operators worldwide. The International Amateur Radio Union was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in [[Inyang]], [[Metzetta]]. The ILRA is a nongovernmental organisation and has no power to pass laws of its own however its guidelines are widely followed by amateur radio enthusiasts and allows for standardisation of band allocation across nations.

== History ==
Following an informal meeting in 1944 of representatives from several nations plans began to be laid for the formation of an organization who could meet the needs of the burgeoning amateur radio hobbyist industry. A constitution was drawn up and ratified on 22nd April 1945, now celebrated as World Amateur Radio Day.

== Governance ==
The ILRA has an elected President and Vice President, an appointed Secretary and other officials (including regional representatives) forming an Administrative Council. The ILRA operates from its headquarters in [[Inyang]], [[Metzetta]] with a small number of external offices in other countries.

articles.title: Derian_identity
articles.snippet:
{{wip}}
'''Derian identity''', sometimes referred to as '''Derianism''', is the proposition that the peoples of [[Dericania]] are related in such a way as to constitute them as a single {{wp|nation}}, the Derian people.
==Etymology==
The term ''Derian'' likely originates from an ancient [[Gaelic people|Gaelic]] term, ''thoir'', meaning "east" or "eastern". The term is first attested to in the 8th century as an {{wp|exonym}} used by people living west of the [[Ionian Mountains]], but it gradually entered common use with the establishment of the [[Holy Levantine Empire|Levantine Empire]] referring to people living in the [[Eastern Kingdom of the Levantines]]. The name Derian thus entered common use and parlance around the [[Dericania#Etymology|evolution of the word Dericania]], with a common root ("thoir") but different meaning, with Dericania evolving from the ''[[Via Dericanus]]''. "''Derian''" as a term referring to a distinct ethnic group, rather than a general term referring to residents of the Kingdom of Dericania, began to be used some time in the 1760s, which is when the modern Derian vs. Deric convention entered common and official use.

articles.snippet:
The '''Great Bull of 1811''' was an act proclaimed by Niall V, [[Apostolic King of Urcea]] in [[1811]]. The Great Bull, one of the last issued by an Apostolic King, deals with the civil rights of Urceans. The Bull both codified existing long-held rights as well as introduced new guarantees as part of Niall's overall liberalizing reform efforts. The Great Bull is considered one of the fundamental texts of the [[Constitution of Urcea]]. It is often referred to as the "Urcean Bill of Rights".

==Text and analysis==

The Great Bull of 1811 is formed by a preamble and nine "that" clauses, known as the nine "statements", each of which guarantees a different civil liberty. A final "that" clause binds the [[Apostolic King of Urcea]] and his descendants to the contents and guarantees of the Bull. Besides the preamble and tenth statement, the nine central statements of the Great Bull each deal with a different social or political right.

In the [[Burgoignesc colonial empire]], a patroon was a landholder, typically [[Mercantile Reform Protestant]], with manorial rights to large tracts of land in the 17th and 18th century. The practice was particularly common in [[Audonia]] and [[Vallos]], and formed the basis for the existence and organization of [[Equatorial Ostiecia]].

During the [[Great Confessional War]], staring in [[1573]] Emperor Leo III, of the [[Holy Levantine Empire]] started a campaign of [[dragonnades]] across the [[Kingdom of Angla]] and the [[Kingdom of Dericania]]. This practice of billeting ill-disciplined troops in prominent Protestant households in order to convince the leaders of Protestant communities to convert to Catholicism or leave [[Levantia]]. It was considered inhumane by the Duke of Bourgondia, who offered aid to the protestants who sought to leave. In exchange for their fluid capital, he granted them patroonships in [[Torlen]], [[Medimeria]], and then in the [[Burgoignesc Kandahar-Kandara Trading Company|Ularien Trading Company]] colonies in [[Audonia]], and [[Alshar]]. The '''Global City Research Institute''' is an LoN-sanctioned NGO that studies the relationships between world cities in the context of globalization. Based out of the School of Humanities and Sciences at [[Newton University]] in [[Alstin (City)|Alstin, United Republic]], the GCRI has, since its founding in 1990, create the a biennial categorization of {{wpl|global city|world cities}} into "Alpha", "Beta" and "Gamma" tiers, based upon their international connectedness through a multitude of factors and variables. 
== GCRI Classification ==
The GCRI examines cities worldwide to narrow them down to a roster of world cities, then ranks these based on their connectivity through on 27 metrics across five dimensions: business activity, human capital, information exchange, cultural experience, and political engagement, and are categorized as follows:
* Alpha level cities are linked to major economic states/regions and highly integrated into the world economy. Alpha level cities are classified into four sections: Alpha ++, Alpha +, Alpha, and Alpha − cities.

The '''Burgoignesc Military Compte Rendu''', is a (currently) annual top-secret report that is published by the [[Burgoignesc Security Forces]] about its strategies, tactics, posture, and most importantly, its gaps and failures. It is submitted as a corollary to the annual budget request for annual appropriations. It is released to the public 20 years after it is published and serves as a primary source for military historians on the needs and concerns of the [[Burgoignesc Security Forces]] at the time of its publication.

==Background==
During [[Operation Kipling]], affairs with [[Urcea]] were becoming extremely fraught and there was a need to identify the root causes. Geo-politically, the relationship was decaying rapidly due to [[Burgundie]]'s public openness to [[Caphiria]] despite the ongoing [[Occidental Cold War]]. However, it was the fact that [[Burgundie]]'s wars in [[Audonia]] and [[Alshar]] were increasing, and none were coming to a conclusion, at the increasing expense of [[Urcea]]'s youth and treasury, that resulted in introspection and change. The '''Family Living Act''' (FLA), formally known as '''An Act to amend the Executive Law, Multiple Dwelling and Residence Law, the Public Housing Law, the Real Property Law, and the Tax Law regarding sale of homes to extended family bidding entities and the development of property for residential use''', is a landmark [[Urcea]]n law enacted by the [[Conshilía Daoni]] in [[2003]] and signed into law by King Aedanicus IX on March 23, 2003. It represents the most significant pieces of [[Housing in Urcea|housing]] and real estate law in the history of Urcea, and is considered one of the signature accomplishments of the administration of [[Procurator]] [[Michael Witte]]. 

The legislation had wide-reaching aims, including impeding the growth of {{wp|suburban}} sprawl throughout the country, reintegrating families and estates, preserving greenspace, and building durable "small urban" communities now known as the [[Housing_in_Urcea#Urban_town_and_country|Urban Town and Country (UTC)]] model.

The Army of Burgundie Force Restructuring Act (ABFRA) was a bill that passed the [[Government_of_Burgundie#Legislative_Branch|ACAN]] of [[Burgundie]] in [[2003]]. It addressed the archaic [[Structure of the Burgoignesc Army]] and to make it more agile and flexible to the 21st century threats and hazards that the [[Army of Burgundie]] was facing currently or was posturing to face in the future. It was the largest overhaul of the [[Army of Burgundie]] since the end of [[Operation Kipling]]. It is considered the crowning military legislation passed during the reign of [[Pasqual I]], the [[Great Prince of Burgundie]]. It remained the premiere 21st century military legislation in [[Burgundie]] until the various legislations were passed as a result of the [[21st Century Burgoignesc Power Projection Stratagem]], put forward by [[Crown Princess Amelia]]. 

Three Combat Corps:
*Foreign Legion (11 combat brigades) focus: expeditionary warfare
*Metropole Forces (7 combat brigades) focus: homeland defense/ready reserve
*Global Support Command (6 combat brigades): humanitarian aid, troops for LUDC/LoN/allied nation mission/treaty requirements, and army-wide comba

articles.title: Council_for_a_Free_Crona
articles.snippet:
The '''Council for a Free Crona''' is an NGO with multiple chapters in most [[Crona|Cronan]] countries and colonial possessions. While composed of several factions and member organizations, the CFC broadly supports equal treatment of native Cronans, national independence in Crona, and a transition to self-rule. The CFC has been labelled a terrorist organization by some postcolonial states and colonizing countries for the actions of militant and protest groups formed with relations to the Council's no-compromise wing.

==History==
In 2031, Kelekonese-born activist and CFC member [[Kiowe Hurit-Souik]] went missing during a conference with the [[Fhainnin-Cronan Cooperative Organization]], which was being lobbied by the CFC for financial support from [[Faneria]]. He remains missing and is presumed dead.

articles.title: Swimming_Pool_Coup
articles.snippet:
[[File:Winston's swimming pool at Chartwell - geograph.org.uk - 2029093.jpg|thumb|Pool where the coup occurred. Most Kiravian swimming pools are shaped like this.]]

The '''Swimming Pool Coup''' ([[Kiravic]]: ''Nevian Sintilinnē'') was a {{wp|coup}} executed by the Kandelite faction of the [[Kirosocialist Party]] (Marxist revisionsists and {{wp|Arab socialism|Kiravian social-nationalists}}) against the leading Devinist faction (orthodox Marxist-Devinists). It is so-named because it began with the execution of Devin and several of his closest allies on the Politburo in a {{wp|swimming pool}} at a state guesthouse in the [[Pelerin Mountains|Pelerin]] foothills of [[Province №7]], clearing the way for a more comprehensive purge that would change the ideological orientation of the [[Kiravian Union]]'s ruling party.

articles.title: Naval_Capability-based_Restructuring_Act_of_2028
articles.snippet:
{{Burgoignesc Security Forces}}
The '''Naval Capability-based Restructuring Act of 2028''' is the [[Navy of Burgundie]]'s residual action following the [[Burgoignesc Military Compte Rendu]] of [[2025]] and the [[21st_Century_Burgoignesc_Power_Projection_Stratagem#Operation_Cavum_Fundamentum|21st Century Burgoignesc Power Projection Stratagem's Operation Cavum Fundamentum]]. It is a sweeping reform to the structure of the [[Navy of Burgundie]], but it is most famous for reorganizing the fleets around amphibious assault ships (AAS) and Expeditionary Mobile Bases (EMBs) instead of aircraft carriers. 
==Background==
As part of the [[Burgoignesc Military Compte Rendu]] of [[2025]], the [[Navy of Burgundie]]'s leadership looked at the mission sets for AASs, EMBs, and aircraft carriers and came to the following conclusions:

**Amphibious Invasion:
***Objective: Execute large-scale amphibious landings to secure and establish control over strategically significant coastal areas.

articles.title: Pareto_Associations

The '''Pareto Associations''' were six different leagues of states within the [[Kingdom of Dericania]] formed in the 17th through 19th centuries. The associations took the form of six year compacts signed in the Prince-Bishopric of [[Pareto]] (in modern [[Rhotia]]) which gave the alliances their name. These alliances were generally established for the purpose of containing the growing power of [[Urcea]] by means of deterence and preventing Urcea from expanding into Dericania. Urcea's centralization and reforms, as well as its territorial gains, made it one of the preeminent powers in the [[Holy Levantine Empire]] after the [[Great Confessional War]] with few peer powers. The first Association was established in [[1611]] and the final one established in the leadup to the [[Third Caroline War]], after which time they were prohibited by treaty. Perhaps the most well known of the Associations was the Second Pareto Association, which included the nascent [[Verecundia|Duchy of Vercuna]], [[Faramount]], [[Pravenza]], [[Hollona and Diorisia]], and a number of smaller entities such as Pareto. Starting in earnest during the [[New Burgundie Secession War]] on the 1920s and ending with the proliferation of thermonuclear ICBMs rendering them ineffective in the 1970s, [[Burgundie]] started a public works program for the production of mass sheltering and Continuity of Government fallout shelters. In [[1925]], the [[Vilaurustre]] defenses were expanded and coastal defenses and flak towers were added. The bunker system built to support these were used as the basis in [[Marialanus (province)|Marialanus]] for a similar system in [[1927]]. The military utility of the bunkers in Northern [[Levantia]] faded as the [[Great War]] shifted from [[Levantia]] to [[Ixnay]] and then [[Crona]], but as the development of long-range, high altitude bombers rendered traditional anti-aircraft measures obsolete, [[Burgundie]] decided to expand the bunkers of the 1920s. In [[1939]], [[Vilauristre]], [[Dorft]], [[ETC]], started a system of municipal bunkers in preparation for long-range bombing runs from [[Caphiria]] or from [[Kistan]]. New Trade-Debt), known outside of [[Crona]] as the '''Trade-Debt System''', is a [[Abioic civilization|Pan-Abioic system]] used partially by [[Tierrador]] through the [[Tierrosphere]], but most notably by the [[Qabóri Woqalate]] to maintain its foreign trade relations with its former colonies. The initial ojawišohê regulated colonial governance after the expansion of Qabóri influence and power during the [[Great Cronan Game]], along the early [[Abioic supply chain]], though it would eventually be reformed in 1335, after [[Istrenya|Qabóri Sokalakee]] was granted semi-autonomy in exchange for trading loyalty to the Qabóri Woqalate. Over the course of a century, the Qabóri colonies of [[Porlos|Porsaahi]], [[Atapakona|Atapak]], and [[Ceylonia|Yapokee]] would be upgraded from a colony to this status, though never granted full independence until the Woqalate's collapse in 1733. articles.title: Resistanceism
articles.snippet:
[[File:Napoleon aura painting.png|250px|thumb|Resistanceist painting of 'Napoleon the liberator of peoples']]
'''Resistanceism''' is a syncretic political ideology originating in 18th-century [[Audonia]] under the rule of [[Napoleon Ziółkowski]], Grand Duke of [[Nasastan]] and later self-proclaimed Emperor of the [[Lunarian Empire]]. Blending elements of spiritual nationalism, mass political participation, imperial anti-colonialism, and decentralised socio-economic management, Resistanceism became a foundational political doctrine for numerous anti-imperial movements in Audonia and South [[Sarpedon]] throughout the 18th to 20th centuries.

== Origin ==
Resistanceism emerged during the reign of Napoleon Ziółkowski (1757–1792), who ascended to the throne in 1776 at the age of 19. Inheriting a rapidly militarising and centralised state, Napoleon initiated sweeping reforms aimed at undermining entrenched elites, empowering meritocratic governance, and mobilising the lower classes for state and spiritual service. These reforms culminated in the ideological formation of Resistanceism, which fused divine egalitarianism, nativist mission, and utilitarian collectivism. A devout Brewer-Alawi

articles.title: Universal_Nationalism
articles.snippet:
[[File:UniversalNatFlag.svg|350px|thumb|Flag often associated with Universal Nationalism]]
'''Universal Nationalism''' is a geopolitical doctrine and socio-political model advocating that every nation or national entity should possess either its own sovereign state or, at minimum, strong cultural autonomy within a broader network of culturally akin states. Central to this ideology is the conviction that the administration of a nation must remain in the hands of its own national collective, and that state structures should take the form of nation-states or ethnofederations; confederations of closely related nations bound together through shared cultural heritage, linguistic kinship, and historical alliances; ie [[Nasastan]]. Proponents reject the concept of anational or civic-oriented states, regarding them as inherently unstable and corrosive to all nations within their borders. In this view, such states inevitably dilute both the identity of the dominant nation and that of subordinate groups, eroding the clarity of who belongs to each collective. articles.title: Counter_Empire
articles.snippet: '''Counter Empire''' ([[Pomorskitong]]: ''kontraimpirium'') is a political concept central to [[Resistanceism|resistanceist]] thought, referring to a unique form of empire that combines the feudal structure of multiple autonomous realms with a strict anti-imperialist doctrine. The idea was first embodied by the [[Lunarian Empire]], proclaimed in 1785 by [[Napoleon Ziółkowski]], a Nasastani military leader and statesman considered the first resistanceist thinker. Though Ziółkowski was not a writer or formal ideologue, his speeches, proclamations, and policies during the founding of the empire became the practical basis for resistanceism. There is no single resistanceist manifesto; rather, the ideology evolved from his actions and the socio-political needs of the era. The concept arose from the aftermath of the [[Lunar Crusades]], a series of conflicts during which [[Nasastan]] expanded its influence across [[Audonia]]. These campaigns resulted in the incorporation of former colonial territories and the establishment of new administrations in previously tribal or horde-dominated Mongol lands. articles.title: Limited_Divinity
articles.snippet:
'''Limited Divinity''' ([[Pomorskitong]]: ''Ńšycidbôgsko'') is a political-theological doctrine of the [[Lunarian Empire]] that established a dualistic model of authority, separating the divine sovereignty of the Emperor from the secular, merit-based rule of subordinate states. Codified under [[Napoleon Ziółkowski]] in the late 18th century, it became a foundational principle of [[Resistanceism]], combining spiritual legitimacy with practical governance. The doctrine holds that the Emperor alone possesses divine mandate, derived from the zmor bloodline traced to the legendary figure [[Kaguja (Zmor)|Kaguja]], while kings, dukes, governors, and other officials exercise authority conditionally. These subordinate rulers are accountable not to divinity, but to the people under their administration. Their duty is the material and cultural well-being of their domains, and failure to meet these responsibilities legitimizes their removal. Limited Divinity thus integrates the sacred and the pragmatic: the Emperor embodies heaven on earth, while local rulers are judged according to their competence in service to the collective good.

'''Kaidoism''' ([[Pomorskitong]]: ''Kaidoézm'') is a [[Nasastan|Nasastani]] political ideology and movement based on the ideas of Načelnik [[Kréstofer Kaido]] (1800 - 1839). Emerging in the early 19th century, it represents one of the principal ideological offshoots of [[Resistanceism]], often described as Nasastan's own internally developed variant of socialist thought. Kaidoism emphasizes the pursuit of [[Final egalitarianism|final egalitarianism]], the gradual equalization and standardization of all facets of social and economic life under a state-managed order. Although initially associated with Kaido’s rule in the 1830s, the term Kaidoism did not enter common usage until the tenure of Načelnik [[Kats Kontor]] (1844 - 1849), whose public identification with Kaido's legacy led to its formal recognition as a distinct ideological tradition within Nasastani politics.

The term Kaidoism derives from the surname of Kréstofer Kaido, Načelnik of Nasastan between 1829 and 1839. The suffix -ism (''-ézm'' in Pomorskitong) was first applied during the late 1840s by political commentators under the [[Aris

articles.title: Model_League_of_Nations
articles.snippet:
'''Model League of Nations (MLoN)''' is an education simulation of various committee meetings based off real-life committee meetings of the [[League of Nations]] (LoN). These meetings are typically extracurricular, centered around political science programs and diplomatic education. MLoN was first popularized in [[Porlos]] following the country's independence in the 1940s, along with the signing of the [[Code of the League of Nations|League of Nations Treaty]] in 1955, and quickly spread in across the rest of [[South Crona]] over the course of the next two decades. As of now, MLoN is one of the most popular extracurricular activities in university settings, with students typically representing all of the LoN member states in several simulated committees.

'''Provincia Levantina''' was a province of [[Great Levantia]] in the center of the empire. It was centered around the [[Norteven River]] basin, extending to the [[Scrovan River]] in the east, the [[Ionian Mountains]] in the south, the Nortevan to the west, and the central Deric highlands to the north. The province was so named due to its status as the first organized province, consolidating the conquests of Levantia in northwest [[Dericania]]. The political and economic center of the province was [[Pareto]], though [[Carsula]] and [[Carinella]] were also major cities. Provincia Levantina was the essential chokepoint of west-to-east travel throughout Great Levantia, as the rest of what would become Dericania were accessible to the Levantine heartlands through the Norteven, which connected across the Ionians by the ''[[Via Ionia]]'' (through the [[Belioné]]), in the north to the [[Avon River]] and thus the ''[[Via Levantina]]'' by sea or short road, and then south and east to the [[Farax River]] basin by way of the ''[[Via Stephania]]''. articles.title: Guided_democracy
articles.snippet:
'''Guided democracy''', also called '''directed democracy''' and '''managed democracy''', is a ''de jure'' {{wp|democracy|democratic}} {{wp|government|government}} that nonetheless functions as a ''de facto'' {{wp|Authoritarianism|authoritarian regime}} or, in some cases, as an outright {{wp|Autocracy|autocratic regime}}. Such forms of {{wp|Hybrid regime|hybrid regimes}} are legitimised by elections, but these elections do not serve to change the {{wp|State (polity)|state}}'s government in any meaningful way but rather are deemed as {{wp|sham election|shams}} designed to keep up the appearance of a {{wp|liberal democracy}}.

In a guided democratic system, elections are directly controlled and manipulated by the government; people are permitted to exercise their democratic rights, but the government ensures that voters cannot change public policy. While they ostensibly follow basic democratic principles, they generally are beholden to a variety of authoritarianism to keep democracy "on a leash". articles.snippet:
[[File:ZD kallistocracy Poster 1937.png|thumb|"Kallistocracy; Live for Another." Recruitment poster for the [[Zabitur'š z duzelzo|ZD Secret Service]], produced in late 1937 to encourage enlistment following the [[Paramilitary Revolution]] and prior to the adoption of the organization's revised insignia.]]
'''Kallistocracy''' ([[Pomorskitong]]: ''Kallistokracéa'', literally ''government for the best condition'') is a political and philosophical doctrine originating in [[Nasastan]] that holds that the primary purpose of the state is to preserve the most desirable form of ordinary human life for the majority of the population. Rather than defining the state through sovereignty, liberty, or divine authority, Kallistocracy argues that government exists to maximize collective convenience, social stability, and interpersonal trust while minimizing unnecessary struggle. The doctrine constitutes one of the central political expressions of [[Zmoric Philosophy]] and the [[Lakhe'žic]] principle of 'easy life', serving as the dominant ideological framework of the modern Nasastani state.

|Girl Guide and Girl Scout}}, {{wp|Ranger (Girl Guide)|Ranger Guide}}). It is one of several worldwide youth organizations.

articles.title: Central_Bank_of_Caphiria
articles.snippet:
The '''Central Bank of Caphiria''' (Latin: ''Uccedonentaria'') is the central banking system of the [[Imperium of Caphiria]]. It was formally created in 1106 by Imperial decree as a result of the political and economic instability at the time. Over time, the roles and responsibilities of the Uccedonentaria have expanded, and its structure has evolved.

The Comitium Consularis is credited with the initial conception and laid out key objectives for monetary policy, what would eventually form the basis for the ''Oeconomici Eendatione Imperium'' (Laws and Governance of Imperial Finance) which created the ''Uccedonentaria'' and '''The Three Points''': Maximum employment, stable prices, and moderate long-term interest rates. The first two objectives are sometimes referred to as the Financial dual mandate and is often revered in a holy manner within the financial elite. Its duties have expanded over the years, and as of 2025 also include supervising and regulating banks, maintaining the stability of the financial system and providing financial services to depository institutions, the Imperium, and foreign official institutions. Throughout history, '''international trade''' has been a staple of the world, from the most affluent nations to the most disadvantaged. This is significantly reflected in the Gross Domestic Product or GDP of the nations of the world, and has allowed countries around the globe to become wealthy and prosperous regardless of their location. articles.snippet:
{{WIP}}
The '''Office of the Treasury''' is one of the eight major agencies of the [[Faneria|Fhainnin]] bureaucracy, and manages the national mint and tax collection services. It was founded in 1907 as one of the earliest bodies of the [[Faneria|Fhainnin Popular Republic]]. Its creation, at the time, was simply as a tax collection agency to allow the setup of a proper government in liberated territories under the Republican government during the [[Fhainnin Civil War]], after which it took over the responsibilities of minting currency and legal documents, as well as providing some internal banking services for the government and public employees.

articles.snippet:
'''Gross domestic product (GDP) is the market value of all final goods and services from a nation in a given year'''. Countries are sorted by nominal GDP estimates from financial and statistical institutions, which are calculated at market or government official exchange rates. Nominal GDP does not take into account differences in the cost of living in different countries, and the results can vary greatly from one year to another based on fluctuations in the exchange rates of the country's currency. Such fluctuations may change a country's ranking from one year to the next, even though they often make little or no difference in the standard of living of its population.

This is a complete '''list of the official languages of countries and dependent territories''' of the world. It includes all languages that have official language status either statewide or in a part of the state, or that have status as a national language, regional language, or minority language.
==Definitions==
*''Official language'': one designated as having a unique legal status in the state, typically, the language used in a nation's legislative bodies, and often, official government business
*''Regional language'': one designated as having official status limited to a specific area, administrative division, or territory of the state (on this page a regional language will have parentheses next to it that contain a region, province, etc. where the language has regional status)
*''Minority language'': (as used here) one spoken by a minority population within the state and officially designated as such; typically afforded protection and designated an officially permissible language for legal and government business in a specific area or territory of the state (on this page a minority language will be followed by parentheses that identify its minority status)

articles.snippet:
{{stub}}

The '''Concordat of Donnebourg''' was a treaty between five [[Ænglish people|Ænglish]] duchies and the [[Holy Levantine Empire]] in 1884. The treaty formed a political union between the five duchies called the [[Avonia|United Angle States]] and reorganized the duchies as "states" considered as integral, inseparable parts of the union. The agreement included negotiators from the [[Holy Levantine Empire]], who had previously [[Nordmontaine_War#Legacy|prohibited]] the creation of a united Ænglish state. The [[Imperial Diet]] ratified the agreement in late 1884, having repealing the earlier prohibition and recognizing Avonia as a free state within the [[Holy Levantine Empire]] the previous year.

articles.title: Twinned_cities
articles.snippet:
A '''twinned city''' or '''sister city''' is a form of legal or social agreement between two geographically and politically distinct localities for the purpose of promoting cultural and commercial ties. The concept also applies to towns and villages. While there are early examples of international links between municipalities akin to what are known as sister cities or twin towns today dating back to the 9th century, the modern concept was first established and adopted worldwide during the [[Second Great War]]. It is common for one city to be twinned with several others.
== Origins of the modern concept ==
The modern concept of town and city twinning has its origins in the [[Second Great War]]. More specifically it was devised on the part of the [[Allies]] to boost morale and build a stronger sense of being on the same team; the first twinned cities were [[Ankae]], [[Metzetta]] and [[Soleramo]], [[Aciria]]. After the war, links were forged between former foes to foster friendship and understanding and as a display of peace and reconciliation. articles.snippet:
'''Country codes''' are short alphabetic or numeric geographical codes (geocodes) developed to represent countries and dependent areas, for use in data processing and communications. Several different systems have been developed to do this. The League of Nations designates each country with both a 3-letter and 2-letter code; the former is often used in sporting events while the latter is most frequently used in top-level domains, but is also used as a prefix for airport and aircraft identification codes. Nations may also choose to add a specific consistent code to their motor vehicle license plates. Every country also has a two or three digit calling code for placing international phone calls.

articles.title: Rapid_transit_systems_around_the_world
articles.snippet:
'''Rapid transit''' or '''mass rapid transit''' ('''MRT'''), also known as '''heavy rail''', '''metro''', '''subway''', '''tube''', or '''underground''', is a type of high-capacity public transport generally found in urban areas. Unlike buses or trams, rapid transit systems are electric railways that operate on an exclusive right-of-way, which cannot be accessed by pedestrians or other vehicles of any sort, and which is often grade-separated in tunnels or on elevated railways.

Modern services on rapid transit systems are provided on designated lines between stations typically using electric multiple units on rail tracks, although some systems use guided rubber tires, magnetic levitation (''maglev''), or monorail. The stations typically have high platforms, without steps inside the trains, requiring custom-made trains in order to minimize gaps between train and platform. They are typically integrated with other public transport and often operated by the same public transport authorities. However, some rapid transit systems have at-grade intersections between a rapid transit line and a road or between two rapid transit lines.

A song or hymn can become a national anthem under the state's constitution, by a law enacted by its legislature, or simply by tradition. National anthems are usually written in the most common language of the state. It is common for the lyrics and melody of a national anthem to be created separately many years apart by entirely different people.

articles.title: Coats_of_Arms_around_the_world
articles.snippet:
A '''national coat of arms''' is a symbol which denotes an independent state in the form of a heraldic achievement. While a national flag is usually used by the population at large and is flown outside and on ships, a national coat of arms is normally considered a symbol of the government or (especially in monarchies) the head of state personally and tends to be used in print, on armorial ware, and as a wall decoration in official buildings. The royal arms of a monarchy, which may be identical to the national arms, are sometimes described as arms of dominion or arms of sovereignty.

An important use for national coats of arms is as the main symbol on the covers of passports, the document used internationally to prove the citizenship of a person. Another use for national coats of arms is as a symbol on coins of the associated state for general circulation.

For a symbol to be called a "national coat of arms", it should follow the rules of heraldry. If it does not, then the symbol is not formally a coat of arms but rather a national emblem. However, many unheraldic national emblems are colloquially called national coats of arms anyway, because they are used for the same purposes as n

'''Parental leave''', or '''family leave''', is an employee benefit available in almost all countries. The term "parental leave" may include maternity, paternity, and adoption leave; or may be used distinctively from "maternity leave" and "paternity leave" to describe separate family leave available to either parent to care for small children. Unpaid parental or family leave is provided when an employer is required to hold an employee's job while that employee is taking leave. Paid parental or family leave provides paid time off work to care for or make arrangements for the welfare of a child or dependent family member.

The '''Treaty of Gaoth''', also called the '''First Treaty of Gaoth''' or the '''Five-Eight Treaty''', was a peace treaty signed between General _____ of Fiannria and ''Rih'' [[Rethys V Suthar-Màrtainn|Rethys V]] of Faneria concluding the [[Fourth Kin War]] between their respective countries. It was signed in the titular city on August 8, 1888. Rethys was forced to sign under duress, being a prisoner of war at the time. The treaty was signed by Faneria to secure the release of its sovereign and the end of the war, which had turned sharply against it in September following the ''Rih''s assumption of command of the Army of the North.

articles.title: Policing_in_Faneria
articles.snippet:
Sherriffs >>> Gendarmes >>> Guard (Local, Civil, National Police)


Law enforcement in Faneria is handled primarily by the [[Office of State Security (Faneria)|Office of State Security]] through the National Police Bureau, Bureau of Domestic Intelligence, and the Bureau of Prison Management ''(need Fhasen vers.).'' The [[Office of the Courts (Faneria)|Office of the Courts]] manages trials and provides its own bailiffs except when additional security is requested from the National Police. Provincial governments locally command detachments of the National Police for dedicated emergency response, with municipalities having their own local police departments to handle day-to-day affairs and county jails.

{{Template:Fhainnin Politics}}

====Sheriffs====
Counties employ their own police forces called Sheriffs; however, these are employed, not elected, and do not have deputization powers. Most counties have a contracted Head Sheriff and an elected Commissioner responsible for enforcing civilian oversight of the police. The '''National Audit Council''' is the judicial branch of the [[Government of Faneria]]. Despite being the highest court in Faneria, the NAC does not act as a final arbiter on appeals, which are handed down to High Courts; instead, it is tasked with the management of the court system and the power of {{wp|judicial review}}, as well as being the body primarily responsible for impeachments within the [[Cananachan Republicanism|Cananachist]] structure of government.

== Structure and Membership ==
The NAC consists of seven members selected from among the existing pool of judges by the [[Directorate of the Republic of the Fhainn|Director of the Republic]] prior to end-of-year approval by the [[National Assembly of the Republic of the Fhainn|National Assembly]]; Auditors being elected upon the death or term-end of a previous member. articles.title: List_of_countries_by_suicide_rate
articles.snippet:
Suicide is defined as the intentional causing of one's death with rates varying from country to country based on various factors from economic ones, to societal and cultural pressures, access to mental healthcare, and a wide variety of other reasons someone may wish to take their own life. Across the board men tend to have a higher suicide rate than women across almost all cultures and countries despite statistics showing women being more likely to have suicidal thoughts leading to what had been deemed a "silent epidemic" of male suicide specifically in developed high income countries. Suicide prevention and mental healthcare remains an issue many countries try to address in many ways with suicide being an action that effects all people.

[[File:CanaspaGIEFlag.png|thumb|right|250px|Flag of the PGRC]]
The '''Provisional Government of the Republic of Canespa''' ('''PGRC'''), also called the '''Canespan government-in-exile''' in some sources, is a political movement and paramilitary organization that claims for itself status as the legitimate government of [[Canespa]] and as organizing umbrella organization for the Canespan opposition.

The organization was established in June of [[2034]] in [[New Harren|Port St. Charles]] by a number of Canespan emigres and academics living in [[New Harren]]. In the midst of the [[2034 Urceo-Canespan diplomatic standoff]], it received legitimate combatant status by [[Urcea]], New Harren, and other members of [[NSTA]], allowing them to purchase arms. In [[2035]], Urcea removed recognition of the PGRC and expelled it from NSTA-area countries following a restoration of relations with [[Canespa]] after its government reforms and the [[Treaty of Port St. Charles]].

The PGRC was criticized by the [[Canasta Company|Canasta government]] as a Urcean-backed terrorist organization and has questioned the ethnic heritage of the organization's members.

articles.snippet:
{{Urcea WIP}}

This article is an overview of several '''cities of [[Rhotia]]''', sorted alphabetically. The cities included are the top largest cities in the country or have specific historical, economic, and political significance to Rhotia specifically and [[Levantia]] generally.

==Aubuna==

Aubuna sits on the west bank of the [[Norteven River]]. Its name means "good water", originating from the Latin ''Aquam Bonam'', referring to its location as the first good water source west of the central Rhotian steppe. Aubuna was preceded by a Celtic hillfort of unknown name only known through archaeology. It was conquered and mostly leveled by the [[Great Levantia|Great Levantines]] between 223 BC and 218 BC after the capture of [[Lente]]. The establishment of Aubuna solidified Great Levantia's control over the Norteven.

Aubuna was the capital of the Duchy of Raganz.

After the [[Third Fratricide]], it was mediatized into [[Dalmirra]], becoming that country's capital.

==Avodun==

Avodun is located on a large bend of the [[Auara River]], approximately 90 miles southwest of the border with [[Galata]].

This article is an overview of several '''cities of [[Lapody]]''', sorted alphabetically. The cities included are the top largest cities in the country or have specific historical, economic, and political significance to Lapody specifically and [[Levantia]] generally.

==Albiga==
Albiga is located astride the [[Deranaut River]].

==Cambeti==
Cambeti is located on the [[Suna River]], approximately 85 miles north of where it flows into the [[Farax River]].

Cambeti was founded as a major city of the [[Galatids]] known as ''Cambeton''.

==Castegnia==
Castegnia is situated on the upper [[Concord River]].

It was established either by, during, or slightly after the expedition of Marcus Tarquinius Clarus, a Levantine general who sought to find and kill the gods of the ancient Celts according to the ''Clariad'', a first-century work of literature. The name of the city means ''place of the chestnuts'', likely indicating either it being a good place for settlers to eat or a pre-extant Celtic religious grove.
